text: What is the core rho -> memory tradeoff demonstrated in this lab?
choices: Larger rho gives shorter memory but keeps the reservoir far from instability
The spectral radius rho has no measurable effect on memory length
Smaller rho gives longer memory at the cost of approaching instability
Larger rho gives longer memory but pushes the reservoir closer to instability
explanation: The lab states larger rho lengthens memory while moving the reservoir toward the stability boundary. The reversed-direction options contradict the measured 1/(1-rho) scaling, and rho clearly does affect memory length.
